question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a purple present, Claire has a gold present, Dave has a red present, Eve has a white present, Fred has a pink present, and Gertrude has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Gertrude and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) purple present
(C) gold present
(D) red present
(E) white present
(F) pink present
(G) teal present
solution:
Present colors are listed in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: black, purple, gold, red, white, pink, teal.
1. Alice ↔ Fred: pink, purple, gold, red, white, black, teal.
2. Eve ↔ Claire: pink, purple, white, red, gold, black, teal.
3. Dave ↔ Eve: pink, purple, white, gold, red, black, teal.
4. Gertrude ↔ Fred: pink, purple, white, gold, red, teal, black.
5. Eve ↔ Bob: pink, red, white, gold, purple, teal, black.
6. Eve ↔ Bob: pink, purple, white, gold, red, teal, black.
7. Gertrude ↔ Claire: pink, purple, black, gold, red, teal, white.
Claire has the black present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
